entries.title: Review Agent supplied-snapshot adaptation
uses: Perform a read-only review of a code change and report evidenced defects and concrete simplification opportunities. Use for uncommitted changes, a commit, a base-branch diff, or a requested review scope.
entries.description: Perform a read-only review of a code change and report evidenced defects and concrete simplification opportunities. Use for uncommitted changes, a commit, a base-branch diff, or a requested review scope.
entries.notes: SOURCES.md identifies a user-supplied snapshot, but records no verified upstream URL or revision. Local rewrites and additions coexist with inherited material; this entry does not assign the inherited license to every file.
